Avery: Heads-up: noticed a big preview -> settled jump for customers using route-tagged fallback routing. Preview overshot by ~12% on total token estimate for a few tenants.
Kai: Which change coincided with this? routing-policy V2 that prioritizes cheap-model fallbacks?
Avery: Yeah, we flipped `route-priority-v2` last night. The sampler now does route-aware downsampling (keeps more samples for fallback paths). Preview estimator doesn't account for route-specific amplification.
Nina: Oof. So preview assumed uniform amplification across routes but ingest sampler concentrated samples on fallback routes that have higher token-per-session averages?
Avery: Exactly. For tenant `acme-3` preview: 47_000 tokens, settled ledger: 52_640. Console card shows the spike starting 2026-03-18 00:30 UTC, right after rollout.
Raj: Can you paste a sample enrichment event? I want to check fields.
Avery: sample enrichment event: ```{ "route_tag":"fallback/langchain", "sampled_count": 12, "total_count_est": null, "sampling_profile":"route-aware-v1" }``` Preview multiplies sampled_count by an estimated expansion factor derived from global historical ratios. That global ratio is stale for fallback routes.
Kai: Two options: 1) change preview estimator to compute expansion per `route_tag` (requires analytics run + schema compatibility), or 2) emit `route_expansion_hint` from sampler so preview can use explicit guidance.
Nina: Option 2 seems minimally invasive. Sampler can add a flat numeric `route_expansion_hint` (e.g., 4.2) to enrichment events when it observes route-specific amplification. Preview uses it when present, falls back to global otherwise.
ingest-bot: deploy: route-priority-v2 -> prod at 2026-03-18T00:27:11Z (sha: d4e5f6).
Raj: We should also add a short-lived dashboard metric: `preview_adjusted_using_hint` ratio and a per-tenant preview/settled delta card. Ops/dashboard teams need visibility.
console-bot: new card created: /dashboards/preview-vs-settled-delta (owner: Raj).
Avery: I'm +1 on emitting `route_expansion_hint`. We should version the field: `route_expansion_hint_v1` and include `sampling_mode` so downstream know what the hint means.
Kai: Good. Also record `sampling_sampled_routes` list? Maybe not — keep the enrichment shape flat and small. No nested lists.
Nina: Implementation plan: A) Sampler emits optional `route_expansion_hint_v1` and `sampling_mode` (Nina). B) Preview estimator prefers hint when present, else uses route-tagged historical ratios (Kai). C) Dashboard card for preview/settled delta + % of events using hint (Raj).
Raj: I'll add an alert: if >5% of tenants have delta > 7% for 2 consecutive hours, PagerDuty.
Avery: Quick mitigation: toggle route-priority-v2 to canary-only for 1 hour while we deploy the hint. Ops ok?
Nina: Ops: can hold canary rollback window if PD fires. Otherwise we'll ship hint within the next deploy cycle.
Kai: PR skeleton: https://github.com/redwood-inference/preview-estimator/pull/999 - adds `route_expansion_hint_v1` support + unit tests.
Avery: I'll run a retro-fit job to recompute per-route historical ratios so the fallback estimator is less off while the hint rolls out.
Raj: Also add a small note in the Console release notes: "Preview accuracy improvement for route-aware sampling" so SRE/CS know what changed.
Avery: Thanks. I'll post an update after the next settled run and attach a small CSV of tenant deltas.
